raids.error.empty_list: Twitch returned an empty follow list. The existing list is kept – a glitch is more likely than “follows nobody any more”.
raids.error.forbidden: Twitch denies access. The “read follow list” permission is probably missing.
raids.error.rate_limit: Too many requests to Twitch. Please wait a moment.
raids.error.unauthorized: Twitch rejected the sign-in. The channel has to be reconnected.
raids.error.unknown_channel: This channel is not in the follow list.
raids.lead: Who the channel follows, who of them still streams – and which favourites are live right now.
raids.name: Raids
raids.no_favorites: No favourites yet. Mark the channels you want to see here in the “Following” tab.
raids.nobody_live: None of your favourites is streaming right now.
raids.none_active: None of the %{total} followed channels streamed within the last %{days} days.
raids.not_synced: The follow list has not been fetched yet. That happens on its own, or you press “Fetch now”.
raids.pending: %{count} of %{total} channels are not checked yet – that runs in the background and takes a few minutes.
raids.perm.favorites: may mark channels as favourite and remove the mark.
raids.perm.sync: may fetch the follow list from Twitch manually.
raids.perm.view: may see the raid page and the favourites.
raids.scope.why: so the raid page can show who you follow.
raids.scope_missing_hint: Without the “read follow list” permission, who you follow cannot be fetched. The channel has to be reconnected once.
raids.window_hint: Shown are channels that streamed themselves within the last %{days} days.
